Independently enumerated all 216 graph automorphisms, evaluated signed fixed-face Lefschetz contributions and eleven trace-profile rows; character sum 432 yields dim invariants 2. All checks exhaustive for this finite graph, though none claim an infinite-family theorem or integral representation decomposition.
